stories.title: Zugbegleiter: Was Zugbegleiter wirklich über uns denken

en.title: Train Conductors: What Train Conductors Really Think About Us
en.summary: Train staff have developed insights into passenger behavior, including how they identify fare dodgers and when they overlook rule violations. The report details observations that railway personnel have made while observing passengers.

stories.title: Flucht aus Sierra Leone: Ein anderes Leben

en.title: Flight from Sierra Leone: Another Life
en.summary: A woman named Rabbiatu has fled Sierra Leone to another West African country, where she lives isolated and rarely leaves her home. Her partner Mohamed is working to bring her back to their former life.

stories.title: Tag der Deutschen Einheit: Zum Geburtstag: Viel Glück!

en.title: German Reunification Day: Happy Birthday!
en.summary: The author reflects on German Reunification Day, which once felt celebratory but now seems like a distant relationship. The significance has changed notably since 2016.

stories.title: Deutsche Einheit: (Kein) Tag der Deutschen Einheit?

en.title: German Unity: (No) German Reunification Day?
en.summary: On October 3, 1990, two German states reunified into one nation. The report examines the current state of German unity and includes a note about Putin's expropriation of the metro.

stories.title: Nordkorea: Nordkorea feuert weitere ballistische Rakete ab

en.title: North Korea: North Korea fires another ballistic missile
en.summary: North Korea's military launched another projectile into the sea according to South Korean reports. The United States stated there is no threat to allied or American personnel.

stories.title: Konflikt mit Südkorea: Nordkorea feuert abermals ballistische Rakete ab

en.title: Conflict with South Korea: North Korea fires ballistic missile again
en.summary: Following an explosion at the border, South Korea called on North Korean leader Kim Jong-un for talks. However, Pyongyang's regime chose to conduct new weapons tests instead of pursuing negotiations.

stories.title: Newsblog zum Nahost-Krieg: Bericht: Wieder Angriff auf Tanker in der Straße von Hormus

en.title: Middle East war news blog: Report of another attack on tanker in Strait of Hormuz
en.summary: A vessel on a major shipping route came under fire once again. The incident occurred approximately eight kilometers from the coast.

stories.title: Todesstrafe: Ärzte kämpfen nach gescheiterter Hinrichtung um Pikes Leben

en.title: Capital punishment: Doctors fight for Pike's life after failed execution
en.summary: Christa Pike survived two doses of pentobarbital in Tennessee and remains unconscious on a ventilator. According to her attorneys, the drug reportedly entered tissue rather than veins.

stories.title: Verletzter Flydubai-Pilot schildert erstmals Angriff im Cockpit

en.title: Injured Flydubai pilot describes cockpit attack for first time
en.summary: A Flydubai pilot attacked by his co-pilot on a Dubai to Tel Aviv flight has spoken publicly about the incident for the first time. Investigations into the background of the attack are ongoing.

stories.title: Angriff im Cockpit: Flydubai-Copilot galt in Oman als Sicherheitsrisiko

en.title: Cockpit attack: Flydubai co-pilot was flagged as security risk in Oman
en.summary: According to US media reports, the Flydubai co-pilot who attacked a pilot was previously suspended from Oman Air over extremist material concerns. Investigators are examining why he was permitted to continue flying.

stories.title: Christa Pike – Tennessee: Nach gescheiterter Hinrichtung intubiert und beatmet

en.title: Christa Pike – Tennessee: Intubated and ventilated after failed execution
en.summary: A Tennessee inmate survived an execution by lethal injection and is now receiving medical care in a hospital. Her lawyers have made serious allegations regarding the incident.

stories.title: Iran-Krieg: Warum gelangt wieder so viel Öl durch die Straße von Hormus?

en.title: Iran war: Why is so much oil again passing through the Strait of Hormuz?
en.summary: Increasing numbers of tankers are transiting the Strait of Hormuz despite Iran launching dozens of drones and rockets weekly in the waterway. The report examines the reasons behind this trend.

stories.title: Kaffeekette: Starbucks wegen neuer Filialen in Xinjiang unter Druck

en.title: Coffee chain: Starbucks faces pressure over new locations in Xinjiang
en.summary: Starbucks is opening cafés in China's Xinjiang region for the first time, prompting a US lawmaker to cite human rights concerns and call for the locations to close.

stories.title: Handelspolitik: Widerstand gegen US-Forderungen bei G20-Treffen

en.title: Trade Policy: Resistance to US Demands at G20 Meeting
en.summary: G20 trade ministers are divided on addressing industrial overcapacity, with several countries opposing US proposals on the matter.

stories.title: Korea: Nordkorea feuert ballistische Rakete ab

en.title: Korea: North Korea Fires Ballistic Missile
en.summary: North Korea launched a ballistic missile into the sea, according to South Korean and Japanese reports, shortly after a statement from Kim Jong Un's sister criticizing South Korea.

stories.title: Künstliche Intelligenz: US-Gericht stoppt vorläufig KI-Nacktbild-Verbot von Musks xAI

en.title: Artificial Intelligence: US Court Halts Minnesota's AI Nude Image Ban
en.summary: A US appeals court temporarily suspended a Minnesota law prohibiting AI-generated nude images after Musk's xAI company challenged it on free speech grounds.

stories.title: +++ Iran-Krieg +++: Flydubai-Copilot galt offenbar zuvor als Sicherheitsrisiko

en.title: +++ Iran War +++: Flydubai Copilot Previously Considered a Security Risk
en.summary: An oil tanker was hit by a projectile off the coast of Oman; Saudi Arabia reportedly plans a new offensive against Houthis in Yemen.
